_note: The fake Feeds' day 2 (B02): everything of day 1, plus a new Ollama CVE, the day-1 Langflow CVE rescored to critical with a fixed version in OSV, and an old Langflow CVE added to KEV. Made up for tests: the ids CVE-2026-991xx and GHSA-fake-* are not real.

nvd.description: Langflow before 1.9.2 lets an authenticated user escape the component sandbox with a crafted flow manifest upload and run code on the server.
Ollama before 0.40.5 follows symbolic links in a pulled model blob, so a malicious registry can overwrite files outside the models folder.

kev.shortDescription: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability in its custom component endpoint.
kev.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
